title: viburnum hainanense f. xanthocarpum
intro: Viburnum hainanense f. xanthocarpum, commonly known as the Chinese Snowball, is a flowering plant species in the family Adoxaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported health benefits, which include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum hainanense f. xanthocarpum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
